description: Implementation of DelinquencyEffectivePauseHelper interface, providing methods to calculate effective delinquency pause periods and days before a date or within a range, based on loan delinquency actions.

classes.name: DelinquencyEffectivePauseHelperImpl
classes.description: Service class implementing logic to process delinquency pause and resume actions for loans.

methods.name: calculateEffectiveDelinquencyList
methods.description: Calculates effective delinquency periods by matching pause and resume actions.

methods.name: getPausedDaysBeforeDate
methods.description: Calculates total paused days before a specific date.

methods.name: getPausedDaysWithinRange
methods.description: Calculates total paused days within a specified date range.

methods.name: findMatchingResume
methods.description: Finds a resume action that matches a pause action based on date overlap.
